Arkansas Valley Christian Mission

Arkansas Valley Christian Mission

The mission is open to provide food and meet client needs from 11am to 2pm every Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday, or by appointment.  All of our services are FREE and CONFIDENTIAL and include the following:

  • Groceries/Client Pantry

  • Employment Resources

  • Health Care References

  • Prescription Co-pay Assistance

  • Fuel Vouchers for Emergencies

Website: https://www.avcmbv.org/Phone: (719) 395-9321Email: ark.christian.mission@gmail.comProvider Type: Food BankProduct Offerings: Providing food from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday, or by appointment.
